items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: That's how I got to know Massimo Freccia a little better than the average musician in the orchestra through music.

ctx.x: the beat just the same. What kind of a guy was Massimo Freccia?

Well, Massimo Freccia was a very nice person, personally. I mean, he was. He's conducting in Italy now, you know. In fact, I came in the same year he came in. And, uh, I was a record librarian. That's how I got to know Massimo Freccia a little better than the average musician in the orchestra through music. Of course, he had a hard time with this, uh, just trying to explain to the musician what he wanted. I mean, you know, he would stop the orchestra and you could see it in his eyes, you know, that he could see…
And Alexander Hillsberg. What did you do?
